app.name: VayuTula
app.description: A daily, room-by-room smog plan that weighs what your family breathes in, what your home emits, and what it costs.
home.promise: A short plan for every smoggy day: what your family breathes in, what your home emits, and what each step costs or saves.
forecast.heading: Outdoor PM2.5 forecast
forecast.empty: Search for your city to see the next 4 days of outdoor PM2.5.

forecast.staleLocal: The forecast couldn't be loaded. Showing the copy saved on this device {minutes} minutes ago.
forecast.failed: The forecast couldn't be loaded right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
search.label: City or area
search.noResults: No places found for “{query}”. Try another spelling.
search.failed: Search isn't working right now. Please try again in a minute.

location.unavailable: Your location isn't available. Search for your city instead.
plan.heading: Actions for your home
plan.intro: Ranked for today with free actions first. Each one is weighed on three pans.
plan.noProfile: Set up your home to see actions ranked for it.
plan.needsForecast: Choose your city above to rank actions for today.
plan.forecastTooOld: This forecast is too old to plan with. Search your city again to refresh it.
